t: What Does "Win a Lifetime Supply" Really Mean? (And Other Existential Quandaries)
s: November 13, 2012 - Winning a lifetime supply does not necessarily mean you should expect boxes upon boxes of the product to show up at your door. To avoid a potential logistical nightmare, some companies elect to offer coupons redeemable in stores for the product. In a VH1 sweepstakes offering the grand prize winner a lifetime supply of Burger King, the winner actually receives a $500 gift card every 6 months for the next 25 years.
